name: @ship/deck-docs
description: The deck documentation site — built with deck, served by deck. A ship-free, SSR'd content site that documents the framework AND exercises its whole native surface (file routing, dynamic [param] routes, layouts, controllers/reactivity, the data seam, SSR + hydrate, HMR, static build) through the real deck CLI. Deck's own docs are deck's canonical example + release test.
